about_the_game:
Float and build your city in the clouds.
Skyscraper Tiles is a calm and creative city builder where your only limit is the sky. Stack futuristic skyscrapers high above the clouds, connect them with elegant skybridges, and fill the air with gentle streams of flying vehicles.

No timers. No stress. Just soothing vibes and satisfying building as you shape your perfect skyline, one tile at a time. Whether you're unwinding after a long day or getting lost in your imagination, this is your peaceful escape to a world above the world.

Features:

🌆 Create Soaring Skylines – Build sky-high cities with a serene futuristic style.
🌉 Connect with Beauty – Add bridges to link your creations.
🚁 Watch It Come Alive – Populate your city with graceful flying vehicles.
🎵 Peaceful Soundscape – Chill music and soft visuals for maximum relaxation.

Sit back, take a deep breath, and start building the skyline of your dreams. Skyscraper Tiles is your cozy corner in the clouds.

short_description: Build your city in Skyscraper Tiles and relax in that sandbox game without resource management! Stack soaring towers above the clouds, connect them with sleek bridges, and unleash fleets of flying vehicles. Craft your dream skyline and watch your futuristic metropolis come to life in the sky!
